title: ClayGraph G1 Temporal Qualified Hybrid Memory Substrate
summary: ClayGraph G1 proposes exact anchors over authoritative FRANK/RAE stores, a persistent temporal/provenance-aware semantic assertion graph, and a transient conservative activation overlay. It rejects treating activation as truth and rejects mandatory physical database monolithism. Primary FRANK integration is M.MEMORY_FABRIC via transient S.ACTIVE_ASSEMBLY; CognitiveFrame and capability authority remain exact/external. A five-query proxy found naive parent-like two-hop activation did not beat lexical retrieval, while a qualified one-hop candidate improved the tiny goldset; full runtime/live-FRANK replication is pending.
negative_results: naive two-hop no recall gain in local proxy
no evidence for all-DB physical merge

external_evidence.implication: Use explicit provenance entities/activities/agents or specialized equivalents.
Keep exact historical system-of-record where justified; materialize projections and do not force event sourcing everywhere.
Temporal validity, episodes/provenance, incremental graph updates and hybrid semantic+keyword+graph retrieval are implementable patterns, not proof of ClayGraph performance.
Temporal graph agent memory has promising author-reported retrieval/latency results.
Temporal conflicts are an active GraphRAG failure mode and temporal retrieval is testable.
Provenance/epistemic stance should not collapse attributed claims into one factual layer.

external_evidence.ref: Reddit r/aiengineering Graphiti retrieval failure example
external_evidence.implication: Having correct graph data does not guarantee query retrieves the right relation; false-association/retrieval quality must be benchmarked.

open_questions: Can candidate gains reproduce on actual current RAE materialization with independent gold queries?
Which of the 71 FRANK stores are exact authority vs derived semantic cache?
Does bounded graph assembly improve Qwen3-4B at equal token budget?
Can crash/replay and privacy gates pass before any store cutover?
evidence_boundary: Architecture/research candidate. External source classes remain distinct; no phenomenal consciousness claim.
